title: Fleet Mechanical Superintendent
description_text:
Our client is a leading maritime company operating a fleet of approximately 35 vessels across the Mediterranean, supporting commercial fishing and aquaculture operations. They are seeking an experienced Fleet Mechanical Superintendent to oversee the mechanical performance and reliability of their fleet, ensuring vessels operate safely, efficiently, and with minimal downtime.
 Position Summary
 The Fleet Mechanical Superintendent will be responsible for managing the mechanical condition of the company's fleet, including propulsion systems, hydraulics, deck machinery, and auxiliary equipment. Working closely with the Fleet Technical Manager, the successful candidate will lead maintenance planning, fault diagnosis, and repair coordination while ensuring the highest standards of reliability and operational performance.
 Key Responsibilities
 Oversee the mechanical condition and performance of engines, gearboxes, hydraulic systems, deck machinery, and auxiliary equipment across the fleet.
 Diagnose mechanical faults and coordinate repair activities with workshops, contractors, and shipyards.
 Plan and prioritise preventive and corrective maintenance programmes.
 Specify spare parts and provide technical support for procurement activities.
 Monitor equipment performance and lead root cause investigations following mechanical failures.
 Provide technical support and troubleshooting assistance to vessel masters, both remotely and on-site.
 Maintain accurate maintenance records and contribute to maintenance planning and budgeting.
 Ensure mechanical work is carried out safely and in accordance with company standards and industry regulations.
 Work closely with operational teams to maximise vessel availability and minimise downtime.
 Requirements
 Marine Engineering qualification or an equivalent mechanical engineering or technical trade qualification.
 Minimum of 5 years' experience in marine engineering, mechanical superintendent, or workshop supervisory roles.
 Strong diagnostic experience with diesel engines, hydraulic systems, and deck machinery.
 Previous experience working with small to medium-sized commercial or fishing vessels is preferred.
 Experience within the fishing or aquaculture industry will be considered an advantage.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
 Excellent communication skills with the ability to liaise effectively with vessel crews, contractors, and management.
 Willingness to travel across Malta and the Mediterranean region when required.
 Fluent in English; knowledge of Maltese or Italian will be considered an asset.
 Experience using Computerised Maintenance Management Systems will be considered an advantage.
 Valid driving licence.
 What We Offer
 Opportunity to manage a diverse fleet operating across the Mediterranean.
 A key technical role within a well-established and growing maritime organisation.
 Competitive remuneration package based on experience.
 Professional development opportunities within an international business environment.
 Dynamic and collaborative working environment.
 Join Our Client's Team
 If you are a hands-on marine engineering professional looking to take ownership of fleet reliability and make a real operational impact, we would love to hear from you. Apply today and take the next step in your maritime career.
